topology: 2 nodes, perftest ib_send_bw over NDR IB
why: perftest takes the newer entry points for both sends and registrations: ibv_wr_* (bypassing ctx->ops.post_send) and ibv_reg_mr_iova2 (bypassing the legacy ibv_reg_mr symbol). Before those hooks this capture had zero ib_post_send and zero ib_mem_region rows, and every other case stayed green
golden: checks/regions only: perftest's own buffer size and access flags, which no argument derives; the rest is asserted
workload_note: ITERS and SIZE are shell variables in job.sbatch, passed as `ib_send_bw -n $ITERS -s $SIZE`; the workload block is the same two numbers in the one place the checks can read them. Not derived, and deliberately left to the golden: the 16384 B per region, which is 2*size only because perftest double-buffers send and receive for its single QP — a guess at an implementation detail, not a derivation from the command line.
qp_creation_note: Every modify_qp must refer to a queue pair some provider recorded creating. That is the invariant regardless of which entry point the application used, which is why the assertion takes the union of ib_queue_pair and mlx5_queue_pair rather than pinning either — pinning one would encode a fact about perftest as if it were a fact about comshu. This assertion was expect_fail from its introduction until 2026-08-05 and was never weakened to close the gap; it went green when the missing door was hooked. The door was verbs_context::create_qp_ex, a function pointer rather than a symbol, which is why nm, readelf and LD_DEBUG=bindings could not name it — all three answer questions about symbols, and ibv_create_qp_ex is a static inline. Entry tracing (COMSHU_TRACE_HOOKS=1, jobs 44233994 then 44234284) settled it. See plans/PLAN-20260805-0053-perftest-qp-creation.
expect_tables_note: ib_queue_pair joined expect_tables on 2026-08-05; before the create_qp_ex hook it was empty on every run of this case.
